gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-alpino: Expressive and unbroken, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like lines that never thin out, while Alpino sits beneath it, cozy and tall-bodied. Unbroken line weight up top is the standout quality.
gen-eater-fs-merriweather-sans: Eater scatters dark, aggressive letters with wide gaps between them, while Merriweather Sans stands below with tall, sturdy lowercase. That sturdy, open-eyed body is the anchor of the whole pair.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans brings sturdy, tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans keeps its feet on the ground under Gugi, whose tall lowercase and stress-free curves are far more showy.
gen-orbitron-fs-epilogue: Wide, spaced-out and exact, Orbitron stretches its letters far apart along the line. Epilogue is curvier and looser, with a tall-bodied lowercase and a wire-like monoline skeleton that feels approachable.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-nunito: Loud, scattered and big-hearted, Paprika fills the line with lowercase that looks like capitals. Nunito's big round bowls and open terminals are the softest, friendliest part of the pair.
gen-unbounded-noto-serif: Unbounded spreads out wide, friendly and oversized in the lowercase. Unbounded is best at broad, welcoming shapes up top, while Noto Serif does its best work with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight.
gen-vast-shadow-manrope: Manrope reads bright and approachable, its curved letters keeping a wide gap at every mouth, while Vast Shadow handles the heading. Vintage, eye-catching letters up top are the pair's loudest quality.
gen-amatic-sc-archivo: Rustic, quirky and hand-drawn, Amatic SC looks squeezed from a tube. Casual charm is its best trick, while Archivo, with a commanding x-height and outward-opening curves, does the steady work.
gen-amatic-sc-satoshi: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC keeps its terminals far from the stem. Satoshi stands tall beneath it, with a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-lexend-exa: Azonix keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, so words take a moment to knit back together. Azonix wins on authority, Lexend Exa on wide, distinct curves.
